title: Scheme evaluation from its isolated components
statement: For any scheme Y, integer complexes P,F and chain map f from F tensor Hom(P,O[0]) to Hom(P,F), if each tensor summand followed by f and each Hom projection equals the actual scheme component [def-pc-scheme-ordinary-evaluation-component], then f satisfies [def-pc-scheme-ordinary-evaluation-formula]. This is an abstract component criterion without any over-site comparison data.

proof.text: Unfold the scheme evaluation predicate and the component construction. Introduce p,q,n,r and p+q=n; the assumed equation is precisely the required equation. The formulas share the same canonical single unit, Hom projections and scalar evaluation, so the definitions agree.
